text: Was 2016 Virat Kohli the greatest speaker cricketer has ever had? Because that year he was so ruthless, so relentless, so utterly ridiculous that at decade later the world is still trying to explain it. Now yes, there are some other contenders. Weaveach else ruled the test cricket in 1976, Avedivula storowed their apart in 2015, but their pick lived in a single format. In 2016, Virat Kohli picked in all three formats at the same time. In test cricket, he was a monster, 1-2-1-5 runs at a staggering average of 75. And then, something truly historic.
